name: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Vasatigruh Nirvah Bhatta Yojna.
description: This is a plan for students of government, government funded and non-affiliated colleges / polytechnics entering the vocational courses set by the government, whose students are certified by the competent authority, as a marginal farmers or whose parents are registered laborers.
department: Higher and Technical Education ,Maharashtra State ,Scheme implemented by Technical Education,M.S , Mumbai
implementingAuthority: Higher and Technical Education ,Maharashtra State ,Scheme implemented by Technical Education,M.S , Mumbai

criteria.label: (As per the GR Dated 07th Oct 2017, 22nd Feb 2018, 01st March 2018, 18th June 2018, 11th July 2019)

evidence.quote: (As per the GR Dated 07th Oct 2017, 22nd Feb 2018, 01st March 2018, 18th June 2018, 11th July 2019)

criteria.label: a) Applicant should have Nationality of India.

evidence.quote: a) Applicant should have Nationality of India.
b) Candidate should be Domicile of Maharashtra State.

criteria.label: c) Applicant should be "Bonafide Student of Institute" and admitted for Professional and Technical courses (Diploma / Graduation / Post Graduation Degree) as mentioned in GR.

evidence.quote: c) Applicant should be "Bonafide Student of Institute" and admitted for Professional and Technical courses (Diploma / Graduation / Post Graduation Degree) as mentioned in GR.

criteria.label: d) Deemed University and Private university are not applicable.

evidence.quote: d) Deemed University and Private university are not applicable.

criteria.label: e) Candidate should be admitted through Centralized Admission Process (CAP).

evidence.quote: e) Candidate should be admitted through Centralized Admission Process (CAP).

criteria.label: f) For current Academic Year, only 2 children from the family are allowed for the benefit of the scheme.

evidence.quote: f) For current Academic Year, only 2 children from the family are allowed for the benefit of the scheme.
g) The Total Annual Income of Family / Guardian should not be more than 8 Lakhs.

criteria.label: h) Minimum 50% attendance in the previous semester (Exception for freshly admitted students in College).

evidence.quote: h) Minimum 50% attendance in the previous semester (Exception for freshly admitted students in College).

criteria.label: i) During the course duration, the candidate should not have a gap of 2 or more years.

evidence.quote: i) During the course duration, the candidate should not have a gap of 2 or more years.

criteria.label: j) Candidates are eligible if they have taken admission under the General category and SEBC Category.

evidence.quote: j) Candidates are eligible if they have taken admission under the General category and SEBC Category.

applicationProcess: For Academic Year 2026-27, apply on the MahaDBT 2.0 portal (fresh and renewal applications). The scheme page on MahaDBT 1.0 remains the information source.

applicationUrlEvidence.quote: Fresh and renewal applications for the Academic Year 2026-27 will be accepted only through the MahaDBT 2.0 Portal.
